physics-killer-01.title: Kwirelsi yerollercoaster engenakukhuhlana into
physics-killer-01.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-01.material: Kwirelsi yerollercoaster engenakukhuhlana into iqala kwindawo A kubude $50\,\mathrm{m}$ ukusuka kwimeko yokuphumla. Ubude bamanqaku amathathu erelsi bubonisiwe etafileni. Indawo B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, indawo C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, indawo D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya kwaye xa $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ukuba isantya ku-C singamaxesha amangaphi esantya ku-B kunye nesantya ku-D ngokulandelelana?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.prompt: Kwirelsi yerollercoaster engenakukhuhlana into iqala kwindawo A kubude $50\,\mathrm{m}$ ukusuka kwimeko yokuphumla. Ubude bamanqaku amathathu erelsi bubonisiwe etafileni. Indawo B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, indawo C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, indawo D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya kwaye xa $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ukuba isantya ku-C singamaxesha amangaphi esantya ku-B kunye nesantya ku-D ngokulandelelana?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.explain: Kuba u-A ukwimeko yokuphumla, ukusuka $mgh_A=\frac12mv^2+mgh$ $v=\sqrt{2g(h_A-h)}$. $v_B=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot5}=10$, $v_C=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot20}=20$, $v_D=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot45}=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ngoko $v_C/v_B=2$ amaxesha, $v_D=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Isantya asilingani nobude obuwileyo, kodwa silingana $\sqrt{\Delta h}$ (impendulo engalunganga ①), ukuba ubude buka-D $5\,\mathrm{m}$ bunqunyelwa njengobude obuwileyo, kuba $10\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (impendulo engalunganga ③), ukuba $\frac12$ iyalityalwa, kuba $\sqrt{10\cdot45}\approx21\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (impendulo engalunganga ④).

physics-killer-01.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
